title: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians
description: Operate, install, adjust, and maintain integrated computer/communications systems, consoles, simulators, and other data acquisition, test, and measurement instruments and equipment, which are used to launch, track, position, and evaluate air and space vehicles. May record and interpret test data.

projection.title: Aerospace engineering and operations technologists and technicians

tasks.text: Test aircraft systems under simulated operational conditions, performing systems readiness tests and pre- and post-operational checkouts, to establish design or fabrication parameters.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets results; human runs physical tests

dwas.name: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Identify required data, data acquisition plans, and test parameters, setting up equipment to conform to these specifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Estimates from specs; human validates assumptions and risk

dwas.name: Estimate technical or resource requirements for development or production projects.

tasks.text: Inspect, diagnose, maintain, and operate test setups and equipment to detect malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Equipment/system inspection requires physical presence

tasks.text: Confer with engineering personnel regarding details and implications of test procedures and results.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Conferring with technical staff on plans is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with technical personnel to prepare designs or operational plans.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Operate and calibrate computer systems and devices to comply with test requirements and to perform data acquisition and analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating systems requires hands-on interaction

tasks.text: Record and interpret test data on parts, assemblies, and mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document test results from provided data

dwas.name: Interpret design or operational test results.
Document design or operational test results.

tasks.text: Adjust, repair, or replace faulty components of test setups and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration of instruments requires hands

tasks.text: Fabricate and install parts and systems to be tested in test equipment, using hand tools, power tools, and test instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fabricating devices needs dexterous hands-on assembly
visual inspection — Quality testing of materials is hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Test quality of materials or finished products.

tasks.text: Construct and maintain test facilities for aircraft parts and systems, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration and upkeep of test equipment

tasks.text: Design electrical and mechanical systems for avionic instrumentation applications.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft technical design docs from provided details

dwas.name: Design electrical equipment or systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

emerging_tasks.task: Operate, test, and troubleshoot uncrewed aerial systems, commonly known as drones, to ensure optimal performance.
